'''Lava Crabs''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]]. 60 rock crabs (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].
==Behavior==
They disguise themselves as stones, sometimes surprising the player. When immobile, they are invulnerable to attack, though they can be hit with a [[Tools#Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to knock them back, making them mobile again.

==Strategy==
Lava Crabs may be differentiated from rocks by striking them with a [[Weapons|weapon]].  A Lava Crab will make a knocking sound and a zero damage indicator will pop up when hit with a weapon, while a rock will not.

The Lava Crab can only be dealt damage if it is mobile, and not hiding beneath its shell.  Strike an immobile Lava Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to make it mobile again. 

Striking a Lava Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] enough times will knock the shell off of its back, and will cause it to flee. Alternatively, setting off a [[Crafting#Bombs|bomb]] near a Lava Crab can remove its shell, and will cause it to flee as well.

[[File:LavaCrabMinusRock.jpg]]

==History==
